rejection_reasons: partition_contamination: development_test was re-split internally and every fraud row appeared in both training and testing
one_class_calibration: calibration partition contained only legitimate labels, collapsing isotonic output to zero
nondeterministic_corpus_generation: builtin hash() caused different corpus digests across processes
missing_readiness_gates: only four gates were checked; ECE, Brier, latency, time-to-alert, per-family recall, and finiteness were absent
evidence_policy: Metrics from this experiment (recall, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC) must not be used for model selection, threshold tuning, or competition claims.
superseded_by: Fix Round 1 commits on codex/apar-sentinel-v5 after 3c5af3c
